name: Dirty Little Secrets
source:
You've moved onto the idyllic Vermillion Lane, but this street hides some sinister secrets, and a sexy neighbor with a mystery of their own.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Dirty_Little_Secrets]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你搬进了风景如画的朱砂巷，然而这条看似田园牧歌般的街道背后却暗藏着险恶的秘密，还有一位本身也谜团重重的性感邻居。

[摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Dirty_Little_Secrets]Choices Wikia[/url]]
